items.text: Health → Settings → Garmin Personal API: paste the key you create on Garmin Connect (it stays on this phone) and tap Test. Hive asks Garmin for yesterday's steps, intensity minutes, sleep, HRV and Body Battery; share the answers so walks and more can be counted from Garmin's own data.

title: No more guessing which photos failed

items.text: After a many-photo import, photos whose QR couldn't be read are kept in Hive: Receipts tab › Without QR. Tap one and its printed fields are read for the tax office's check; it leaves the list once the receipt is saved.
The import report can delete the saved photos from the gallery (Android shows them and asks first; they stay in the trash for 30 days), so only the ones still to do are left.

title: Fewer steps for receipts without QR

items.text: On the tax office's page in Chrome, long-press the receipt's QR code → Share image → Hive Receipt, and it's saved: no screenshot, no picking. A receipt link shared to Hive Receipt works too.
Receipt without QR → "Copy all four" puts the four values in the keyboard's clipboard, so in Chrome you tap a box and pick the value instead of typing it.

Wallet → Receipt without QR: Hive reads the four fields and shows them the way the tax office's form takes them (3000,61 · 255797/257650). Open the form in Chrome, send it, screenshot the QR code it shows, come back and pick the screenshot: the receipt is saved like a scan.

Wallet → Receipts → pick a company (e.g. Obsidian IT) → Report: the month's total, VAT per rate (20%, 10%) and every receipt. Send it as a PDF or a CSV for Excel with the buttons at the top; pick another month or All.
A receipt's PDF now has its QR code under the text, like the paper one, so anyone can check it with the Tax Administration.

title: Delete by swiping, many photos at once

items.text: Wallet: swipe a receipt from right to left to delete it. Swipe all the way and it's gone (Undo in the bar below); stop halfway and a red bin stays there to tap.
From photos: pick many receipt photos at once. Hive reads every QR code (even several in one photo) and lists each photo with what happened: saved, already there, or why it failed.

Walks (and runs or rides) your Garmin detects by itself now count toward Training time, so a short hard workout plus a walk can close the ring. A walk you did start on the watch still counts once. Needs Garmin connected in Health → Settings; the day screen lists what the watch detected.

Wallet → Receipts → Prices: every item you've bought, searchable ("jabuke" finds JABUKA, "mleko" finds MLEKO 2,8%). Each product shows the cheapest chain, every chain's last, lowest and average price, a price chart and every purchase.

Shops and pumps count per chain, not per branch: NIS in Novi Sad and NIS in Ruma are one NIS, Maxi, Idea and Univerexport the same. The fuel diary now compares chains and says how many of their pumps you used.

Same product, different spelling? Open it: Hive suggests look-alikes (same brand, same size, so K Plus and Z Bregov milk stay apart) and you merge them, or pick any other with "Same product as…". The pencil picks the name it's shown under, from the printed ones or your own. Shops and pumps work the same: tap a chain to rename it or join it with another.
Wallet screens keep a solid top bar, so the list no longer shows through the title and buttons.
The number under a card's code only shows when it's something a cashier could type in (like 124321254); long random QR codes no longer print a wall of characters.
Saving a new card takes you straight back to all your cards, where it now sits, with a small Card saved note.
Wallet → a receipt → Receipt as printed now fits the screen width and sits in the middle. Tap PDF to share it as a clean black-on-white PDF, e.g. for the accountant.
Fixed the crash when opening Music with the new frosted glass.
If Hive ever crashes, the home screen shows what broke next time, with Share details, so it can be fixed fast.

A new look for Music: near-black navy with neon cyan, blue and teal light behind real frosted liquid glass (it blurs what's behind it as you scroll), with rainbow-edged rims where the light bends, like Apple's new glass.
Download stays lively before you paste a link: tinted glass with a hint, then a glowing cyan button once the link is in. Slider, progress and the play button glow in the same colors.

title: A daily coach, one tap from Claude

items.text: Every morning at 06:00: a notification with an Ask Claude button. It opens the Claude app with yesterday's workout, last night's sleep, HRV and resting HR, the four days before for a trend and today's plan, all written out. Send it and you get Yesterday / Today / Watch.
Share the reply to Hive Coach (or Paste reply) and it shows on the Week tab in a new Daily coach card. Tapping a coach notification opens a Coach screen with today's check-in and the weekly review.
Ask Claude and Paste reply are now always on both coach cards, with or without an API key. Turn the daily one off in Settings → Notifications.

title: The coach without an API key

items.text: Health → Week → AI coach → Ask Claude: the Claude app opens with your week written out. Send it, then share the reply to Hive Coach (or copy it and tap Paste reply) and it shows in the card like before.
Sunday at 19:00 a nudge reminds you to ask, and the prompt is also saved as coach-<week>.json (with an empty response the reply fills in) in your Hive backup folder.
Music now wears the website's look: ice white buttons, teal highlights, deep blue-black with soft teal and blue light behind, and the same frosted glass on every card.
A new app on the home screen. Paste a link, or in YouTube tap Share → Hive Music, and it downloads as MP3, M4A or OPUS, or as video.
Speed it up for the pool or podcasts: 0.5× to 3×, the pitch stays the same. Presets Faster 1.5×, Podcast 1.75×, Music and Video 1080p, or save your own.
Options: quality, mono, normalize, trim silences, whole playlists, split by chapters, cover art. Files land in Music/Hive Music (Movies for video) or Downloads.
A player with the cover blurred behind, a glass mini player, lock-screen controls and its own speed. yt-dlp updates itself once a day.
All your spending now lives in Money: scanned receipts from Wallet show up there by themselves, next to what you type in, and count in budgets, reports and the monthly net.
Business or personal: pick All, Personal or a company at the top of Spending and Reports. Receipts with a company's PIB go there on their own, and typed expenses can be marked for a company too.
One set of categories: Money's. Money → Setup → Receipts from Wallet decides where each kind of receipt goes, and a receipt's category chip in Wallet files it under any Money category.
Wallet is now the papers and the cards: receipts with their items, warranties and fuel diary, and your loyalty cards. Tap a receipt in Money to open it in Wallet.
Hive settings (gear on the home screen) → Backup: pick a folder on your phone, e.g. Documents/Hive. Every app goes into one file there once a day: two weeks of daily copies plus one per month.
The folder is yours, so it stays even if Hive is deleted. After a reinstall Hive offers to restore from it; you can also restore any backup file or share it to Drive.
Your intervals.icu and Anthropic keys now live apart from your data: no backup carries them, not even Android's own Google backup.

title: Wallet: no-QR receipts, fuel diary, faster at the till ⛽

items.text: QR code won't scan? ⋮ › Receipt without QR: photograph the bottom of the receipt, Hive reads the four printed fields (total, PFR time, PFR number, counter) and finds it at the tax office, items and all.
Fuel diary (Receipts › Fuel diary): price per liter month by month, the stations you use from cheapest, liters and money this year, and liters per 100 km when you type the odometer on a fuel receipt.
Cards faster: a Wallet · Cards home-screen widget, a Cards tile in Quick Settings and a Cards shortcut on the Hive icon. Tap a card and it opens straight at the till.
At the till the card fills a clean white screen: just the code, the number and full brightness. Pin your favourite cards to the top (⋯ › Pin to top).

title: Loyalty cards that look like cards 💳

items.text: About 65 Serbian loyalty programs now have their own card: their colors, their motif (Lilly's dots, Vulkan's X, Benu's crosses, Gigatron's gold corner…) and their logo.
Start typing a shop when adding a card and Hive suggests the program; tap it and the card, colors and code type are set.
Want it exactly like the plastic? Add a photo of your card and Hive shows that instead.
Every program exercise is now a kettlebell exercise with kettlebell steps. Where only a dumbbell photo exists, it says so; the movement is done with a bell.
Done now tells you how the day went: volume vs last time, records, kg per minute, and from the watch how long you worked and rested.
Strength days show your sets right under the verdict, with ↑ = ↓ against last time and ✓ On Garmin Connect once copied. The watch part no longer repeats the tiles at the top.
New per exercise: Last set to failure? Had more at 8+ reps means the next session suggests a heavier bell.
Form after a workout comes with a word: fresh, neutral, training or overloaded.
Receipts show the shop's logo and its everyday name (NIS, Lukoil, Gigatron…) instead of the long company name.

Spending per week with the weekly average, and the month by Shops or by Categories (fuel, groceries, tech, home, clothes, sport, pharmacy…). Tap one to see its receipts; change a receipt's category by tapping it.
Save receipts with the star and find them under ★ Saved.
Coming from Mani? ⋮ › Import from Mani (CSV): its receipts and groups come in. Scan one of them later and the full receipt with its items replaces it.

Loyalty cards know common programs (Moj Maxi, Lidl Plus, SuperKartica, Laguna, Vulkan…): their color, logo and whether the till reads a QR code or a barcode. Add a photo of the card to see it as it really looks.
Wallet joins Hive, with two tabs: Receipts and Cards.

Scan the QR code on any Serbian fiscal receipt (or pick a photo or screenshot, or paste the link). Hive asks the tax office for it and keeps the shop, the date, the payment, every item and the total. Offline? It's saved and read later.
Fuel receipts show liters and the price per liter. Receipts tab: spending and liters per month, your top shops, search over shops and items.
Personal or company: a receipt issued to a company (its PIB on the receipt) is marked as that company's. Filter Personal or by company, name each company once, or change who a receipt is for.
Warranties: add one to anything you bought (6 months to 5 years, or your own length). Hive shows how long each still runs, warns in its last month and lists them all on the Receipts tab.

Loyalty cards: scan the card's barcode, read it from a photo, or type the number. At the till Hive shows the same barcode at full brightness, so the plastic can stay at home. Cards are panes of tinted glass, like the rest of Hive.
A gym day is green when the workout is done; skipping the sauna no longer turns it orange. Saunas still count toward the weekly sauna target.

Log reps and kg on the phone while the watch records: when you finish, Hive copies your sets into the watch's activity on Garmin Connect. The watch keeps its timing, heart rate and load. Not synced yet? Open the day and tap Copy sets to Garmin.
Single-arm and single-leg exercises are now per side: reps mean each side, volume counts both, and the watch step says "per side". Toggle Per side on any exercise.
Strength days show the sets from the phone first, then what the watch measured.
Books joins Hive: what you're reading, everything you've finished with ratings and notes, and the queue of what's next (to read, to buy, dropped).
Add a book by title, author or ISBN (Open Library fills in pages and the cover), or by hand. Each book has a core idea, key concepts, notes and an after-reading checklist.
Reading sessions with a timer, pages per hour and a daily-minutes ring; Stats shows books per month and year, the yearly goal, reading days, topics and your top rated.
Quotes with page, theme and your own take; a quote of the day, search and favourites. Export / import in Books settings, and Find covers fills covers and page counts from Open Library.
Dates now read the European way (31.10.2026, 31 Oct) in every app.
Prefer ISO or US? Tap the gear on the home screen (or Health settings / Money setup) and pick a date format.
Home: tap the pencil (or hold an app card) to move apps up or down and switch off the ones you don't use. Their data stays.
Habits and Money now have Tabs and sections like Health: hide or reorder whole tabs and every section in them (the grid icon at the top, or Tabs in edit mode).
Money → Income → See all: every payment you've logged, grouped by month with month totals. The same for expenses under Spending.
Search by note, source, category, amount or date, and filter by year, source or category and paid or invoiced, with the total of what you see.
Tap any payment or expense to edit or delete it, for example to mark an invoice as paid when the money arrives.
A new Reports tab in Money: income, spending or net for any year, month by month, with each source or category in its own color. Tap a month to see everything in it.
By source and by category: totals, share of the year, monthly average, and the trend of each one when you tap it.
Running total against last year and your goal pace, savings rate, spending by weekday, the biggest payments and expenses, and insights in plain words.
A new app on the home screen: Drawify. Pick a picture and it floats over the camera, so you can trace it onto paper.
Drag, pinch and rotate it, adjust the opacity, make white transparent or turn a photo into an outline, mirror it, lock it in place.
Tilt correction keeps the picture flat on the paper when the phone is at an angle, or drag the four corners yourself. Share any picture to Hive to open it in Drawify.

title: Habits and Money join the hive 🐝

items.text: Two new apps on the home screen: Habits and Money. Streakli now lives inside Hive, and everything stays on your phone.
Habits: daily habits by part of the day, to-dos, mood, streaks, a month grid, a yearly dashboard with insights, reminders and two widgets. Close the day for a little celebration.
Money: income by source with exchange rates, paid vs invoiced, a yearly goal with pace and levels, and monthly budgets for your spending.
All three apps share the same cards, charts, rings and hold-to-edit sections.
New daily rings at the top of the Week tab, like Apple Health: steps, training time and sleep to start, with a small ring for every day of the week.
Pick up to 4 rings and set each target: steps, training time, workout calories, today's plan, Zone 2, intense minutes, kg lifted, swim, run, sleep, sauna or a weigh-in. Hold the card to edit.
Weekly targets stay for what adds up over the week. The rings widget now shows today's rings.
A notification when you close all your rings, and at 20:00 a reminder of what's left (both switchable in Settings → Notifications).
Close them all and the app celebrates: confetti, honeycomb sparks and your rings spinning in, with your streak of perfect days.

title: Sleep and weight, easier to see 🌙

items.text: Last night's sleep chart now sits on the Week tab, above Recovery. Tap any day to see that night.
No chart yet? The app now tells you what's missing: Health Connect here, and sleep sharing in Garmin Connect.
The weight chart in Trends shows every weigh-in instead of weekly averages, so daily entries draw a line right away.
Line charts, in the app and in widgets, now draw smooth curves.
Tap or slide your finger along any line chart to see the exact value for that day or week.
When sauna is on for a workout, the Garmin workout gets a sauna timer after the last exercise, counting your minutes.
A new name and a new icon: a honeycomb in honey and the app's colors. Look for Hive on your home screen.
Health stays the first cell of the hive. More apps, like Habits, will fill the rest.
A new sleep chart on each day: awake, REM, light and deep sleep across the night.
A sleep score with efficiency, time to fall asleep, time awake, regularity and sleep debt.
Trends shows your last 14 nights by stage. Needs Health Connect turned on in Settings.
Stride is now Health, the first app inside Tend. More apps, like Habits, will join it here.
Opening the app shows your new home screen with today's plan. Widgets, notifications and shortcuts still go straight into Health.
After every update you'll see what's new right here, so you never miss a feature.
